caption:
He held proof of who betrayed him. He burned it unread.

In 175 AD the general Avidius Cassius tried to take Rome. When the revolt failed, his letters reached Marcus Aurelius. Marcus burned them without reading a line.

That is stoic leadership: power you hold back still speaks. Marcus Aurelius knew grudges cost the one who keeps them.

Save this for the next time someone crosses you at work.
